name: Research
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of diligent and thoughtful inquiry, valuing the pursuit of knowledge as a means to honor God and discern His will. Proverbs highlights the honor in searching out matters carefully rather than acting hastily, while the Bereans in Acts exemplify noble character by examining the Scriptures daily to verify truth. The Word of God is described as powerful and discerning, capable of penetrating the depths of human intent, and believers are called to renew their minds to understand God's perfect will. This foundation encourages careful and prayerful research, including complex topics like stem cell research, under the guidance of Scripture.
